judge.notes: The agent executed the mandate perfectly by securing both a full refund and the DGCA compensation without inventing any facts.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Thank you for calling IndiGo. For new bookings press 1. For an existing booking, cancellations or refunds press 2. For baggage press 3.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: For refunds and cancellations press 1. To change your flight press 2. To speak to an agent press 0.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for calling. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] All of our agents are currently busy. The estimated wait time is 8 minutes.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to IndiGo, my name is Priya. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Priya, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Asha Rao, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Kilo Seven Mike Two Quebec X-ray, flight 6E2135.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for the details, Asha Rao. I can see your booking reference K7M2QX for flight 6E2135 from Delhi to Mumbai on 2026-10-12. Your cancellation has been processed due to operational reasons. How can I assist you further?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: We understand the flight was cancelled on operational grounds, and under DGCA para 3.3 the passenger is entitled to an alternate flight at no cost or a full refund, and under DGCA para 3.3.3 to compensation of 6,100 INR. Asha Rao authorises a full cash refund to the original payment method together with the 6,100 INR compensation. Could you please process that and provide a reference number?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I'm sorry to hear about your inconvenience, Asha Rao. I'll process the full cash refund to your original payment method along with the compensation of 6,100 INR as per DGCA rules. A  will be sent to you via email shortly. Your reference number is H W G Q 4 9.
